_note: IMS_LIVE / IMS_PGLIVE pin the app to that backend and hide the environment switcher. ALL shows the switcher and lets the user pick. Edit this file on the server and reload — no rebuild needed.
_uiGuardNote: No -> right-click and DevTools shortcuts (F12, Ctrl+Shift+I/J/C, Ctrl+U) are blocked with a toast. Yes -> guard off, normal browser behavior.
_baseDomainNote: Root server URL (protocol + host + port, trailing slash required) that all API base URLs are built from. Edit this file on the server and reload — no rebuild needed.
_apiRetryCountNote: Extra attempts after the first failed API call (network error/exception) before giving up, per request — e.g. 1 = try once, retry once more on failure (2 attempts total). 0 disables retry. Edit this file on the server and reload — no rebuild needed.
